name: wdr-connect-db
description: WDR Database connection utilities layer - use AWS Secrets Manager or environment variables for configuration

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy-deps && npm run compile && npm run create-package
scripts.copy-deps: mkdir nodejs && cd nodejs && npm init -y && npm install pg@^8.16.3 @aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager@^3.490.0 @aws-sdk/rds-signer@^3.490.0 @smithy/node-http-handler@^3.0.0
scripts.create-package: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = 'nodejs/node_modules/wdr-connect-db'; fs.mkdirSync(dir, {recursive: true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({name: 'wdr-connect-db', version: '1.0.0', main: 'index.js', type: 'commonjs'}, null, 2))"
